Hi Michael — thanks for the heads up and the files.

Short answer: our ingestion pipeline prefers the bank posting timestamp when available; however if the remittance XML contains only a generated-at UTC time we fall back to that value for automated VAT tagging. That fallback is what's likely happening here.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm whether the attached XML includes an element for bank_posting_time or only file_generation_time? (I had a quick look, looks like file_generation_time only.)
- If you can, reply with the bank trace ID (or we can work from the screenshot) and we'll run a manual reapply for the affected invoices so the VAT month aligns.

I'll loop in Vanessa and Irene to confirm virtual-account routing wasn't doing a pre-match.

Best,
